messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Midweek release train — quick confirmations. We have 2 deploy slots tomorrow 10:00-11:00 UTC (slot A) and 15:00-16:00 UTC (slot B). Please confirm owner, smoke owner, and rollback readiness. Planned changes: slot A: feature/latency-tuning (inference service, includes model quant change), slot B: infra/dedicated-autoscale. Reply with 'owner / smoke / rollback: yes/no + notes'.

Marta Lopez: I'll take slot A owner. smoke: Devon Reed. rollback: yes — runbook updated and validated against staging. tagging @devon

Devon Reed: Got it — will run smoke tests for slot A. Smoke checklist: healthcheck, 1k QPS soak, a handful of model sanity prompts. I'll post the run command here.

Devon Reed: ```./smoke-run --target inference-service --qps 1000 --duration 600 --checks health,latency --prompts smoke_prompts.json```

Chris Patel: I'll own slot B. smoke: Jin Park. rollback: partial — infra rollback needs on-call approval but we have a snapshot and terraform revert ready (see runbook).

Jin Park: Confirmed smoke for slot B. Plan: canary at ~15:05 UTC for 10m at 10%, then metrics check (error rate, p50/p95/p99, infra CPU).

Olivia Martin: Heads up — slot A includes model quant changes. Important: add cache-bust to the runtime to avoid stale KV cache across versions, otherwise token generation mismatch can occur. I updated the deploy template with a flag.

Taylor Nguyen: Noted. @Olivia can you add the cache-bust flag and set canary % to 20% for slot A? Also confirm there are no incompatible model weight changes.

Olivia Martin: Added cache_bust=true to the deploy template and bumped canary to 20% for slot A. PR: https://git.company/redeploy/1234 — please review asap. No incompatible weight format changes.

Chris Patel: For rollback, infra snapshot id is snap-20260311-45. Runbook link: https://wiki.company/release/runbooks/infra-rollback. If infra approval needed, page lists who to ping.

Taylor Nguyen: OK final checklist: - Owners: Marta (A), Chris (B) - Smoke owners: Devon (A), Jin (B) - Rollback: Marta yes (app-level), Chris partial (infra approval required) - Canary: A 20% for 10m, B 10% for 5m - Post-smoke message in this thread with results - If any red metrics, halt and rollback. Anything missing?

Marta Lopez: All set from my side. I'll be on standby in #eng-oncall during slot A.

SRE Bot: deploy-scheduler scheduled slot A at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z and slot B at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. Runbooks attached: /runbooks/slot-A, /runbooks/slot-B

Devon Reed: Copy — starting smoke at the top of slot A, will paste output here.

Devon Reed: smoke started. quick note — latency p95 spiked to 180ms at minute 3 but settled to ~120ms by minute 8, no error rate increase. continuing to monitor.

Taylor Nguyen: Thanks. Please post final pass/fail and upload smoke logs to /artifacts/releases/2012345678. If anything looks off, abort and call the rollback.

Devon Reed: PASS. Logs uploaded: https://artifacts.company/releases/2012345678/smoke-A.log

Jin Park: Canary for B done — 10% for 5m. Metrics OK, small increase in tail latency but within SLO. PASS. Logs: https://artifacts.company/releases/2012345678/smoke-B.log

Taylor Nguyen: Great — proceeding with ramp to 100% per plan at end of canary windows. If anything funky, we abort. :thumbsup:
